notes.title: ELEGIES: Aya Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

It's been a while since our last update and we're happy to announce that we added full controller support to ELEGIES: Aya!

Additionally we also added a few small changes and bugfixes:

 Updated German translation
 Updated several voiceovers
 Fixed a bug where the text after a choice was not voiced depending on which answers were picked first
 Fixed a bug where text force-finished while Auto is active


If you notice any other bugs that were not adressed in this update, please contact us via email at support@dreamsquircle.com or write us on our Discord server so we can tackle them next!

Thank you for playing ELEGIES: Aya!

notes.title: ELEGIES: Aya Demo Update 2.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are happy to launch update v 2.2 of our ELEGIES: Aya demo right in time for our upcoming Kickstarter campaign!

I've been working fulltime on ELEGIES: Aya since January 2022 and together with all of our awesome artists we've made a lot of progress in the development of our upcoming visual novel! While we are looking forward to get ELEGIES: Aya finished in the next few months, we still have a lot of finishing and polishing tasks ahead of us to ensure our game will meet your expectations. Additionally we made a decision with huge impact to our game's development (and my backlog): 

We will be adding full voiceovers for all main characters!

Update v 2.2 of our ELEGIES: Aya demo contains the following changes:

 Voiceovers were added for Zach, Aya, Claire and Tyrrell
 Added volume settings for all characters
 Improved our game's music
 Added the option to jump back to a previous line in the backlog
 Fixed a bug of the Chinese translation not showing correctly
 Fixed performance issues when saving and loading
 Fixed performance issues after loading a choice
 And many more small bugfixes

If you like our demo and want to share your impression with us, you can discuss it with us on our Discord!

We are also launching a Kickstarter for ELEGIES: Aya on February 7th! 
If you wish to support us even more and / or want to grab some cool merchandise, please follow us so you don't miss it:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dreamsquircle/elegies-aya

You can also find us and stay updated on our Social Media:

 Twitter
 Instagram
 Facebook

Thank you for supporting us and I wish you all the best!

- Jürgen from Dream Squircle
